summary: ASX slid to a three-month low, XJO -0.88% to 8,672.5, as an oil shock (Brent ~$107) and US 10yr yields near 5% forced risk-off. Materials -2.21% was worst on a gold-miner unwind (RMS, OBM, KCN, CYL). Defensive Health led (+1.50%; 4DX +8.72%, TLX +8.63%). EQR +11.69% on a US tungsten JV. Smart Money rotated into insurance and energy. RBA decision 29 Sep (4.35%).
